custody.producer: Claude owns the versioned outcome-cross-runtime/v1 vocabulary, reference and fixture bytes.
custody.consumer: OpenCode owns this adapter test harness, assertions and scoped port record.
custody.codex: Codex owns its independent direct-port consumer; no implementation is copied from it.

consumer.loader: Repository file path, isolated module name, scoped sys.path and sys.modules restoration.
consumer.positive_assertion: parse_strict_json -> matching bundled validator -> canonical_json plus newline encoded as UTF-8 equals the original fixture bytes.
consumer.additional_assertion: The valid discovery protocol negotiates version 1, preventing an always-rejecting negotiation implementation from passing.
consumer.unknown_field_assertion: Strict parsing succeeds; discovery structural validation raises CompatibilityHaltError with code schema-field-unknown.
consumer.future_version_assertion: Strict parsing and structural validation succeed before negotiate raises CompatibilityHaltError with code protocol-version-skew.
consumer.oracle: Pinned producer bytes and producer-defined rejection codes; no duplicated schema or expected JSON objects.

runbook.approved_scope: Fixture-only test-data import with adapter-owned tests; regeneration and installed-host restart are not applicable to unchanged installed behavior.

steps.1_source_authority: Pinned existing producer commit and exact Git blobs/SHA-256; retained primary-producer snapshot bytes verified against the pinned tree evidence.
steps.2_conflicts: No skill, command or agent added; installed inventory unchanged.
steps.3_regeneration: Not applicable: no plugin payload import/refresh; the wholesale port tool is not executed.
steps.4_hook_review: Existing bridge, mappings and deferred set preserved byte-identically; no new hook boundary.
steps.5_diff_review: Only six fixtures, one test module, this scoped record and four documentation files.
steps.6_portability: Saga PORTABILITY describes test-only behavior and limits.
steps.7_validation: One targeted six-case pytest invocation, narrow Ruff lint/format checks and the real existing validator; prior 24 local cases not repeated. Full hosted candidate validation remains required.
steps.8_install_verify: Not applicable: no installed surface change; no installer, host restart or host-discovery command is executed or claimed.
steps.9_cycle_record: This record plus narrow matrix, README and CI-note updates; existing port records and installed manifest unchanged.

unchanged: all bundled scripts, hooks, references and runtime data
installed skills, commands, agents and inventory
original five Python test modules and TypeScript driver
preservation.documentation_exception: plugins/saga/PORTABILITY.md is updated to record this scope; no executable or installed inventory artifact changes.

validation_contract.environment: Existing staged locked Python 3.12.3 environment; no installation or sync; isolated HOME/temp and no inherited credentials.
validation_contract.execution_receipts: External OpenCode01 t14-opencode-neutral-fixtures evidence records commands, case outcomes, preservation and checked rollback.

limits: No peer-envelope CLI ingress or new host behavior.
No assertion of authority transfer, protected handoff execution, GitHub reconstruction or host compatibility.
This cycle does not claim whole OpenCode01 completion.
